BudgetRow.description: A global budget from config.toml: spent (settled plus reserved) in its current period against its limit.
BudgetRow.title: BudgetRow

Changes.description:
The workflow page's "What changed" data: the newest runs with metrics (oldest first) and the change markers
inside their time range.
Changes.title: Changes

DriftCard.description: An open drift with its alert text: `title`, `cause` (what likely changed) and `doing` (what PitStop did).
DriftCard.title: DriftCard

EventRow.description: One event. `summary` is a one-line description of at most 300 characters; the raw payload is never sent.
EventRow.title: EventRow

Explain.description: L5 attribution around a drift's change point `at` (`pitstop explain`).
Explain.title: Explain

FeedItem.description: One pit-wall feed entry. `id` is "<kind>:<row id>" (a drift id, an event id or a run id).
FeedItem.title: FeedItem

Graph.description:
The run graph over one run (`run_id`, `window` null) or the newest runs started in `window`, at most 200.
`slowest_path` lists node ids from the root, each step the child with the largest `time_per_run_s`; it is empty
when no node has a known latency.
Graph.title: Graph

GraphNode.description:
One run-graph node (decision 8). `id` is "workflow", "agent:<path>", "llm:<agent path>|<model>" or
"tool:<agent path>|<tool name>", the path being the agent names joined with " › "; `agent_path` lists those names
(for a leaf, its agent's). An agent's calls, cost and runs cover everything under it, and the root's too (its
runs are every run in scope); their latency is not measured (null). `time_per_run_s` is the node's time over the
runs in scope divided by their number, its unknown latencies counted at the mean of its known ones (an agent's:
the sum of its children's known times), null when nothing under it has a known latency. `time_partial` is true
when an agent's or the root's time sums only part of its children (one is unknown or partial itself): a lower
bound. A leaf is never partial.
`run_ids` are the runs in scope that touched the node, newest first, at most 20.
GraphNode.title: GraphNode

GraphVerdicts.description: Verdict events on a node: `gate_reject` counts gates with `allow` false, `tool_error` errored tool results.
GraphVerdicts.title: GraphVerdicts

Marker.description:
A change to mark on the charts, at `at` (epoch seconds). `model`, `base_url` and `prompt_versions` markers
carry the tag's value `before` and `after` (the run `run_id` is the first with the new value) and `source` (their
runs are compared only with runs of the same source); an `l2_alarm` marker is an L2 drift's change point, with
its `drift_id` and `metric` (`before` and `after` are null).
Marker.title: Marker

Point.description:
One run's L2 metrics. A rate (`tool_error_rate`, `refusal_rate`) is a fraction in 0..1 (the UI shows it as %);
a metric the run has no data for is absent.
Point.title: Point

RunRow.description:
`cost_usd` sums the run's agent-meter `llm_call` costs and `llm_calls` counts those calls; `verdicts` counts
its block, steer, halt and fallback events.
RunRow.title: RunRow

Tile.description:
One workflow on the pit wall (decision 6). `flag` is red for an open P0 or a latest run that is halted or
refused, yellow for any other open drift, else green; `flag_label` says the same in words. `headline` is the most
urgent open drift's alert title (`headline_level` its level). Spend is today's agent-meter spend against the
latest run's daily `budget_usd` (decision 7).
Tile.title: Tile

WorkerStatus.description:
The background worker: `enabled` is false under `--no-worker`. `last_scan_at` (epoch seconds) and
`last_scan_runs` are from the last completed scan pass; `last_error` is the exception type name of the last
failed step, cleared by the next completed scan.
WorkerStatus.title: WorkerStatus

WorkflowSettings.description: A workflow's settings as its latest run recorded them (they are set in code).
WorkflowSettings.title: WorkflowSettings
